description: KNaTiH₂O₃F₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one KNaTiH₂O₃F₄ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three O and three F atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.81 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.65-2.89 Å. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one O and six F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.86 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.57 Å. Ti is bonded to two O and five F atoms to form distorted edge-sharing TiO₂F₅ pentagonal bipyramids. Both Ti-O bond lengths are 1.89 Å. There are a spread of Ti-F bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Ti, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.46 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one K and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ti, and one O atom. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one K, one Na, and one Ti atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to one K, two equivalent Na, and one Ti atom to form distorted corner-sharing FKNa₂Ti trigonal pyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one K, one Na, and one Ti atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
